text:
The bowl looks like a medium salad bowl, roughly 20 cm across, and it holds chopped chicken or tofu on a bed of greens with some broccoli.

The pieces are white and look like grilled chicken breast, or possibly tofu. The cubes are piled fairly high. I estimate about 150 g of protein, plus about 40 g of greens and about 30 g of broccoli, for roughly 220 g in total.

If it is chicken breast, 150 g comes to about 250 kcal. The greens and broccoli add about 20 kcal. Any oil would add a little more, so I estimate about 290 kcal in total. If it is tofu, the total would be lower, so I settled on about 280 kcal.
